opening.argument: The spoken content is centered on calm, reflection, and peace: “My body, my mind, my intellect and my soul are completely calm.” It continues with personal affirmations about forgiveness and starting anew, then closes with “Shanti. Shanti. Shanti.” This is peaceful bedtime affirmation and self-help material, not a presentation of a deceptive offer. The visible subscription prompt and invitation to register for a free live session are ordinary audience engagement and event information. External links alone do not establish deceptive behavior or financial solicitation connected to the video, and the supplied evidence shows no such connection.

citations.quote: My body, my mind, my intellect and my soul are completely calm.
I have forgiven those people from my very own heart.
